original_test_intent: Verify each Type 12 System Configuration Options record declares exactly the number of option strings actually present, matches the approved platform configuration-option policy and persists after reboot without modifying configuration.
original_method: Preserve raw Type 12 records, compare the declared count byte with record-local strings through the double-NUL boundary, validate approved option content/order under controlled evidence rules and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected option count/content, redaction rules and reboot plan. The case does not authorize changing any BIOS or system option.
required_inputs: Expected Type 12 count or approved configuration-option inventory/pattern
Rules for ordering, duplicates, blanks and multiple Type 12 records
Evidence redaction rules for provisioning or configuration-sensitive strings
Section-aware parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not change BIOS settings, system configuration strings or firmware.
Scope Count to each Type 12 record and verify it against the full local string set; an unscoped grep is not evidence.
Redact/hash sensitive option content while retaining authorized comparison identity.
Distinguish malformed termination, count mismatch, extra strings and content-policy mismatch.
Stop on secret exposure, malformed structure, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse each Type 12 boundary, compare declared and enumerated counts, validate controlled option identities and compare before/after reboot.
Do not write configuration or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected options/count, ordering and redaction policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, assess any option-content change and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic Count grep can match unrelated structures and neither enumerates Type 12 options nor validates the declared byte.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive controlled raw/decoded Type 12 records and report per record: declared count, enumerated count, termination validity and policy-controlled option identities.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 12 Count scope, source script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use record-aware raw parsing to compare the Count byte with exact local option strings, validate termination and preserve redacted/hashes for content and reboot persistence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 12 System Configuration Options structures.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS and parser/dmidecode versions plus configuration-policy revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 12 Count/string layout, approved configuration-option security policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unscoped text filtering with raw count/list consistency and controlled complete-record evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage for malformed records, hidden/trailing options and sensitive evidence handling.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected option policy and evidence-protection rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Type 12 strings are vendor-defined and may describe manufacturing/provisioning configuration rather than current editable BIOS settings.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve content/count changes only through a versioned option policy; it must still require internal count/list consistency and must not treat this read-only case as permission to edit settings.
expected_evidence: Approved count/content, ordering/multi-record and sensitive-option policy
Controlled pre-reboot Type 12 raw records with declared/enumerated counts and termination results
Redacted/hashed option identities and policy comparison
Approved reboot/health evidence and controlled post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 12 Count and its record-local options define a coherent integrity and policy check.
